sections.position: Marketing Manager @ Acquaint Softtech Private Limited
sections.bio:
I’m Zubair Pateljiwala — a digital growth strategist with 15+ years of experience helping startups, SaaS companies, and service brands scale visibility, rankings, and revenue through organic SEO and AI-optimized content frameworks.

I don’t follow trends. I build systems that outperform them.

⸻

🌱 What I Do:

Organic SEO Strategy
From technical audits to topical mapping, internal architecture, and real-time ranking refinement — I help brands win search without chasing ads.

AI & LLM-Optimized Content
My content is crafted to show up where users are searching next — whether it’s Google’s SERP, AI Overviews, or language models like ChatGPT and Gemini.

⸻

🚀 Results That Stick:

I’ve helped brands reach Page 1 in competitive SaaS, development, and hiring niches — including ranking a Laravel development company page for 10+ commercial-intent keywords within 45 days.

I’ve delivered:
	•	Traffic boosts of 50–300% in under 12 weeks
	•	Keyword domination in tech/service SERPs
	•	SEO systems that scale — with or without a content team

⸻

🛠 How I Work:
	1.	Deep keyword research + intent clustering
	2.	Semantic content strategy aligned with user behavior
	3.	Technical SEO, schema, speed & UX optimization
	4.	Internal linking that builds authority from within
	5.	Real-time refinement via GSC, GA4, and SERP intelligence

⸻

❌ No gimmicks. No guesswork.

I don’t push plugin tricks or overpriced audits. I bring frameworks that fuel long-term organic visibility — on Google and the AI interfaces that follow it.

⸻

✅ If You’re Looking For:
	•	A strategist to rank your SaaS, dev, or hiring brand — in both Google & AI
	•	Evergreen content ecosystems with AI-readiness built in
	•	Actionable strategy you can scale, not just insights you can read
	•	A human, no-fluff partner who knows what works and why

Let’s talk. Growth doesn’t wait.
📩 DM or connect with me here on LinkedIn.

posts.text:
I have been doing SEO and content marketing for 15 years across multiple B2B brands.

Here is what the last 6 months of focused execution actually produced for Acquaint Softtech Private Limited.

Real numbers. No paid ads. No shortcuts.

- 827 keywords ranking on Google
- 5,700+ monthly organic visitors
- 37,800+ backlinks earned naturally
- 1,700+ referring domains
- DR 62 built entirely through content
- Pages now cited inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot answers

That last point is the one I am most focused on right now.

Google rankings still matter. But in 2025, if your content is not showing up inside AI generated answers, you are invisible to an entirely new generation of search behavior.

This is not theory. These citations happened because of one deliberate shift in how I write content.

Human first. Search intent second. AI readability third.

No keyword stuffing. No generic articles. Just content that actually answers what people are asking, in a way that AI models trust enough to cite.

15 years taught me that the fundamentals never change.

Only the platforms do.

If you want to understand how AI citation works or how to get your content into LLM answers, comment SEO below.

I will personally reply to every single comment.

P.S. Next milestone is 10K monthly organic visitors. Will share the update when we get there.

#SEO #ContentMarketing #DigitalMarketing #AISearch #LLMO #OrganicGrowth #B2BMarketing #SearchEngineOptimization #LinkedInGrowth #MarketingStrategy

sections.title: Why work with me
sections.body:
I have spent 15 years doing one thing really well — making B2B content rank, get found, and now get cited by AI.
Here is what my SEO and content marketing work actually produced for a software company I work with:

- 827 organic keywords ranking on Google
- 5.7K monthly organic traffic growing consistently month over month
- Pages cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot through AI optimized content strategy
- 37.8K backlinks built through content that earned links naturally
- 1.7K referring domains across competitive B2B categories
- Top 3 rankings for staff augmentation, Laravel development and remote hiring keywords
- DR 62 domain rating built entirely through organic efforts

I write for LinkedIn the same way I write for search. Specific audience, clear point of view, and a result attached.
My audience are marketers, founders and SaaS operators who follow me because I show my work, not just my opinions.
If you want a creator who understands organic growth from the inside out, I have the receipts to prove it.
